+    module = gpu_model_runner_module

+    def allocate_graph(size):
+        memory["free"] -= size
+        memory["graphs"] += size

+    def init_cache():
+        memory["free"] -= 5 * GiB_bytes  # 2 GiB KV and 3 GiB workspace.

+        memory["graphs"] = 0
